comment: Both gate outputs run inverted against the Mutable manual, which has HIGH TIDE going high at the end of the rise and LOW TIDE going high at the end of the fall, each staying high until the cycle restarts or the envelope is retriggered. The plugin holds each one high through its segment and drops it at the end, so the lines describe the plugin. Clock sync differs too: the manual engages the phase-locked mode by holding the range switch for a second, while the plugin locks to the CLOCK input whenever a cable is patched there. The Sheep firmware also disables clock sync: set_sync is called with the CLOCK input's connected state ANDed with the firmware being off.
